title: Bundle
description: A product bundle: parts that hold parts, consts, and values of any JSON type.

version.description: The version of the bundle format, always 2.

sealed.description: Always true: a bundle ships sealed.

parts.description: The parts, each of which may hold another part.

label.description: Any JSON value but null, printed on the box.

meta.description: Any JSON value the sender attached, null included.

part.description: One part, which may hold another part inside it.
